cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/testft2.c <<'C'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <ft2build.h>
#include FT_FREETYPE_H
#include FT_MULTIPLE_MASTERS_H
#include FT_ADVANCES_H
int main(int argc,char**argv){FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb");fseek(f,0,SEEK_END);long n=ftell(f);fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET);unsigned char*b=malloc(n);fread(b,1,n,f);fclose(f);FT_Library lib;FT_Init_FreeType(&lib);FT_Face face;if(FT_New_Memory_Face(lib,b,n,0,&face)){puts("newfail");return 0;}FT_Set_Char_Size(face,20*64,20*64,72,72);FT_MM_Var* var=NULL;int e=FT_Get_MM_Var(face,&var);fprintf(stderr,"mm %d var %p axes %u\n",e,var,var?var->num_axis:0);if(!e&&var){FT_Fixed*c=calloc(var->num_axis,sizeof* c);for(unsigned i=0;i<var->num_axis;i++)c[i]=(var->axis[i].minimum+var->axis[i].def)/2;e=FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates(face,var->num_axis,c);fprintf(stderr,"set %d\n",e);free(c);free(var);}for(int i=0;i<20;i++){FT_Fixed adv=0;e=FT_Get_Advance(face,i,FT_LOAD_DEFAULT,&adv);fprintf(stderr,"getadv %d e=%d adv=%ld\n",i,e,(long)adv);}return 0;}
C


cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I freetype2/include -I freetype2 /tmp/testft2.c -o /tmp/testft2 freetype2/objs/.libs/libfreetype.a -lm && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/testft2 /workspace/poc3.ttf
